# Nick Anderson

> https://www.nickanderson.us/

Personal research site of Nick Anderson, a PhD candidate in Economics at The New
School for Social Research. Empirical work on public finance, banking and
financial history, and the construction of long-run economic data. This site is
the author anchor of the Heterodata research-data ecosystem.

Hand-authored, and deliberately richer than the generated form. The Arcanum Site
Kit generator `tools/make_llms_txt.py --site nickanderson` now succeeds (a
`sites[]` entry was added to ecosystem.json on 2026-07-24), but it emits only the
Data/Code/Outputs resource block. This file additionally lists the pages and the
papers, so it is maintained by hand. Keep it in step with the site.

## Pages

- Home: https://www.nickanderson.us/ — the archival coverage timeline and an index of projects
- Research: https://www.nickanderson.us/research.html — three papers in full, with figures
- Economics at The New School: https://www.nickanderson.us/tnse.html — institutional history and the Anwar Shaikh Papers
- AI Tools: https://www.nickanderson.us/aitools.html — open-source research tooling
- Projects: https://www.nickanderson.us/projects.html — every site and repository
- Data: https://www.nickanderson.us/data.html — datasets and downloads
- About: https://www.nickanderson.us/about.html
- Contact: https://www.nickanderson.us/contact.html

## Papers

- Duration and Public Finance in the United States, 2001-2023 (PDF, 128 KB):
  https://files.heterodata.org/duration-public-finance/treasury-debt-duration-paper.pdf
- Tax Revenue Cyclicality: The U.S. Example 1800-2020 (PDF, 2.9 MB):
  https://files.heterodata.org/tax-revenue-cyclicality/us-fiscal-policy-revenue-cyclicality.pdf
- Historical Balance of Payments Data: Comparing the United States and Germany —
  ongoing; read on https://www.nickanderson.us/research.html

## Data

- All data downloads: https://files.heterodata.org
- Landing-page dataset (source coverage matrix, 21 families):
  https://www.nickanderson.us/data/coverage.json
- FreeNIC full Parquet release: https://data.freenic.org

## Outputs

- Research hub: https://heterodata.org
- Dissertation (Volcker): https://volcker.org

## Notes for agents

- The landing page figure 4,965,894,572 is the exact sum of the 21 source
  families in /data/coverage.json. It is not rounded and should not be quoted
  as "about 5 billion".
- Row counts and table counts must be quoted from the same artifact: the
  coverage matrix pairs 4,965,894,572 rows with 58 base tables.
- License: site content (c) Nick Anderson. Code in the linked repositories
  carries its own license, generally MIT.
